hazards: The bridge and the upper ring carry no rails where the reference shows none.
Hallway 1's crossing threads between the deck supports at ground - blind at both mouths.
doubts: Scale: long axis 52 m DERIVED; a Forge walk (channel b) replaces it.
The sunken power-up trench (shots 1/6) is below-grade geometry a top-down cannot bound; flattened to floor level in this blockout, owed to channel (b).
Upper decks float (pillar positions unknowable from overheads); the shots show octagonal pillars - terminal adds supports during the editor pass.
Interior doorways under decks are open at their edges pending the walk.
